authoredFrom: M60 ontology workstream, 2026-10-03. Every shape is transcribed from real corpus text and the expectation counts come from validation/m14/fixtures/sql/construct-probe.json and ontology-census.json over the 1,460-file census (BB_CORPUS_ROOT=/home/ishaq2321/bb_tests/repositories). Measured: 143 `psql_meta_command` nodes of which 22 are `\ir`/`\i` with a literal filename across 6 files and 0 with a psql variable; 666 OR REPLACE declarations of which 15 replace a declaration in the SAME file; 20 same-kind re-declarations WITHOUT OR REPLACE (excluded on purpose, PostgreSQL rejects those); 6 phantom columns named `LIKE` in 2 files. The `\ir` forms are verbatim from postgrest/test/io/fixtures/load.sql, the OR REPLACE function pair is the shape of postgrest/test/io/fixtures/schema.sql, the function-and-trigger twin is hasura-engine/server/src-rsr/migrations/10_to_11.sql lines 7 and 25, the composite-type construction is hasura-engine/v3/crates/engine/tests/db_definition.sql's `ROW(3421, NULL)::institution_songs`, and the LIKE clause is verbatim from proxicall/database/migrations/20260613_coms_p13_4_data_retention.sql. Section 5 (`CREATE EXTENSION`) is measured from the same census: 27 `module` symbols, one per `create_extension` declaration, of which the analyzer published none as an edge before this round.
comment: The forbid rows are the substance of this fixture, not the expect rows. Each of the three new emissions is a place where the obvious implementation publishes something false: an `imports` edge for every psql meta-command (121 of the 143 nodes are `\echo`/`\set`/`\gexec`, which name no file), an `overrides` edge for any name a file declares twice (Hasura's `CREATE FUNCTION hdb_catalog.f()` and `CREATE TRIGGER f` are two different objects sharing a name), and an `instantiates` edge for any cast to a named type (`x::my_enum` converts a value that already exists, and a DECLARED type is not itself a construction site). The phantom `LIKE` column is pinned from both sides: the keyword as an UNQUOTED column name is forbidden while a QUOTED `"like"` column is required, because a text-only guard would delete the quoted one and that is the shape a legal column actually takes.

forbidRelationships.target: this is a message, not a dependency

expectRelationshipCount.note: 3 psql file includes + 2 CREATE EXTENSION installs. Both are `imports` and both are `external`-free/true respectively; the count is split by metadata because the two mechanisms answer different questions.

note: `importType: sql_import` is not decoration. src/ast/pool-worker.ts already names five lanes that declare their own import type and lists `sql` among them, so shared machinery is reading a value this lane never produced; a psql include is what it is for. The `line_number` key is one of four spellings the worker accepts (range.startLine, line, line_number, lineNumber) and is written explicitly because the worker's own comment records that every import in every language once arrived at the store with `line: 0`. `expectSymbolCount` on `d13_twin` equals 2 is the same-name-different-kind pin: a table and a trigger, which is why the analyzer counts them as two symbols and must not count them as a redefinition.
